The '''Murianic Languages''' are a major branch of the [[Zhensanovian Languages]] associated in source material with the northern and central highlands of the [[Union of Zhensanov]].

Source material describes Murianic languages as fusional, with complex case systems, grammatical gender, rich verb aspects, and a traditional runic script. The source also presents Murianic as one of the largest and most influential Zhensanovian branches.

== Canon Limits ==

Speaker totals in the extracted source come from later reference framing and should not be treated as 1994 census facts until Zhensanov demographic canon is reviewed.
